about: Hand-labelled (clause, bot) pairs. 'expected' is the correct verdict written from the clause and the bot's settings, before any system was run. source=real means the wording comes from one of the five real RBI circulars in eval/extract_texts; synthetic clauses are written in the style of RBI directions. label_confidence=review marks labels a reasonable reviewer could dispute; reports show results with and without them.
